reference: 14 discovery batches; two mass-weighted actual-state medoids per batch/time; 51 times
evidence: Prior endpoint-distance reward did not fit actual states. New request requires exact current state and matched learning/control support.
formula: R(q,s)=T log sum_r pi_r exp(-MMD_sigma(q,Y_r(s))/T); delta=bounded eta*RMS(native)*gradient/RMS(gradient).

parameters.sigma_source: median within-molecule nearest-neighbor spacing pooled over discovery reference frames
parameters.temperature: .03 engineering starting value, dimensionless kernel distance
parameters.caps: inherited conservative .025 A per atom, 1.25 A cumulative RMS, newly severe receptor pair guard

selection_reason: Establish true-state gradient/zero equivalence before increasing complexity.
primary_metric: batch mean symmetric bidirectional Hungarian atom-assignment RMSD, fixed receptor frame
promotion_policy: Require at least 2% lower primary mean vs incumbent and both adaptation batches improve; atom/bond changes separately reported. Only 2 adaptation batches, no significance claim.
reproducibility: This is an evidence/formula/parameter decision record, not private chain-of-thought.
execution_interpretation: Main explicit gradient-guidance goal: disable built-in SMC, retain new coordinate gradient; native and zero controls included. No response to optional wording clarification at launch.
